chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Hasten to return the containers of gifts, for that is quicker in bringing about their continued exchange.

key_terms.الْهَدَايَا: Gifts that are exchanged between people
key_terms.تَوَاتُرِهَا: Their recurring continuity or repeated succession
key_terms.عَجِّلُوا: Hasten; do it promptly without delay

ai.seo_question: Why should gift containers be returned quickly in Islamic etiquette?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches an etiquette of gift-giving: promptly returning the vessel or container in which a gift was sent helps preserve goodwill and encourages repeated exchange. The hadith highlights refinement in social conduct and attentiveness to the rights and feelings of others.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Hasten to return the gift containers, for it encourages the continuous giving of gifts."
